serviceStatus.title: Service status
serviceStatus.scope: Runtime status of the publicly listed subscription nodes and access paths.
serviceStatus.fetchError: The update failed. Previous status is hidden. Please try again.
serviceStatus.offline: You are offline. Previous status is hidden; we will refresh when the connection returns.
serviceStatus.expired: The status report has expired. All nodes are shown as unknown until new data arrives.
serviceStatus.empty: No subscription nodes are currently listed publicly.
serviceStatus.categoryHint: Category counts show operational / total. Open a node to see the evidence.
serviceStatus.limitations: Status summarizes inbound, forwarding and tunnel signals for public nodes. It does not guarantee access from your client to a destination website. No traffic does not mean a failure.

reasons.no_data: Not enough runtime data has arrived yet.
reasons.stale: Reports have expired; awaiting new observations.
reasons.config_pending: Configuration is awaiting application; runtime status is not confirmed.
reasons.component_failure: A required component reports a failure.
reasons.no_route: No usable access path is currently available.
reasons.partial_failure: A usable path remains, but some candidate or backup paths have failed.
reasons.partial_unknown: A usable path remains, but some candidate paths have unknown status.
reasons.unsupported: Available data or capabilities cannot confirm the status.
reasons.external_path: The path includes unmanaged forwarding; its full status cannot be confirmed.
reasons.maintenance: The administrator is maintaining this node.

serviceStatus.closedHint: Sign in to the user portal to check the status of nodes available to you.
